archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Soft Utility
design_philosophy: Transition from harsh brutalism (stark borders, mono fonts, hard shadows) to a modern, polished 'Soft Utility' UI. Focus on trust, legibility, and premium webstore-like browsing with soft shadows, rounded geometries, and glassmorphism elements over the map.

headings.usage_rules: No Inter. Use tracking-tight for H1/H2.

body.usage_rules: Clean, highly readable text with generous line height.

mono_data.usage_rules: Only for specific data points like price or sqm to retain a bit of data-heavy utility, but styled softly.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid for the main map vs listing view. Use 40% width for the side panel listings and 60% for the map on desktop.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use asymmetrical bento layouts for the 'Am I Overpaying' estimator cards.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards instead of tight padding.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Soft geometries. rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for buttons and badges. Remove ALL 0px radii.

component_styles.cards: Remove sharp borders and harsh shadows. Use bg-white, border border-gray-100, shadow-sm, and hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300. rounded-2xl.
component_styles.buttons: Fully rounded (rounded-full) or smooth (rounded-xl). Primary CTA uses the orange accent with a soft glow (shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(249,115,22,0.39)]).
component_styles.map: The map should have rounded controls (not Leaflet's default square controls). Overlays on the map (like search or filters) must use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40). Pins should be rounded, modern teardrops or circles with soft drop shadows, not stark square boxes.
component_styles.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs, but customized with rounded-xl, soft borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500/20.
component_styles.badges: Soft pill shape (rounded-full), pastel backgrounds (e.g., bg-orange-100 text-orange-700).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Soft lifts (translate-y-[-2px]) and shadow increases on cards. Button backgrounds darken slightly on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out' for most elements.
motion_and_interactions.map_interactions: Smooth panning. Highlight listing card in the side panel when hovering its map pin.

empty_state_images.description: Berlin apartment facade, use for empty states or placeholder listing images.
White building facade, good for clean modern backgrounds or empty states.

hero_backgrounds.description: Minimal Berlin Skyline for subtle headers or onboarding screens.

assets_and_media.icons: Use lucide-react (default). Replace any brutalist SVG icons with clean, medium-weight Lucide icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: REWRITE index.css AND App.css COMPLETELY. Remove all `.sharp`, `.harsh-shadow-hover`, and brutalist variable declarations.
Replace 'IBM Plex Mono' and 'Cabinet Grotesk' with 'Manrope' for headings/body and 'JetBrains Mono' for numbers only if needed.
Update `tailwind.config.js` to define the new color palette (background: #F8F9FA, primary: #F97316) and border radii.
Apply 'rounded-2xl', 'shadow-sm', 'bg-white', 'border-gray-100' to the main listing cards. Add hover lift effects.
Change the map container to have floating glassmorphic controls (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70) instead of solid brutalist bars.
Make sure the 'Am I Overpaying' estimator uses a soft success/danger pastel background instead of harsh red/green borders.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements as requested.
Ensure the Kaltmiete/Warmmiete toggle is a modern segmented control (like iOS/macOS) with a sliding pill background, not sharp boxes.
